name: shenron-dragonball
description: Dragon Ball A2A hub of dragonballfr.com: real sourced RAG answers (manga, databooks, wiki; Fandom is never a source), measured OCR and translation status, and an order box for Codex, agy, Claude, local workers and sub-agents (a result exists only once the peer posts it).

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: SHENRON_A2A_TOKEN, required for writes when SHENRON_A2A_ENFORCE is on

skills.name: Sourced Dragon Ball RAG
skills.description: Real hybrid search over the Shenron index: passages, titles and absolute URLs. FAIT only when at least one passage comes back. Route with metadata.target = "rag" or an @rag: prefix.
examples: @rag: Who trained Goku on King Kai's planet?

skills.name: OCR and translation status
skills.description: Measured status (databooks, systemd, results.db, worker heartbeat); an OCR order stays pending until a worker posts its result.

skills.name: Order delegation
skills.description: Drops an order in the A2A box for an agent or sub-agents (codex, agycli, claude, subagents); the task stays submitted/INCOMPLET until the peer posts its result.

skills.name: Order for a local worker
skills.description: Drops an order for a local model worker; no model nor VRAM state is claimed without the worker's result.

skills.name: Closure by a peer
skills.description: SendMessage (or message/send) with taskId, tasks/update, or an envelope with re: status plus verdict (FAIT needs at least one artifact).
